subject: Reopen joeconsorti/duo-fold-live donor work as bounded current-HEAD research lanes
body: Donor learning existed, but current implementation adoption is not proven by policy/design artifacts alone. New audit checks Duo Open main 7127c287a17fd97050c98fbeb05a38f7318f2f64 against donor HEAD 8ca4371bf4c83ea6c840a2d500325e55635245be and creates bounded lanes for hinge source/freshness/failover, smoothing, logical display routing vs physical panel ownership, physical Fold7 scenario matrix, orientation/reversal, bug-driven diagnostics, and deferred abstraction work. Duo-specific extensions prioritize physical wake vs logical readiness vs FIRST_PRESENTED/FIRST_USEFUL/FIRST_INTERACTIVE and predictive prewarm because the inner-screen wake delay is an observed product problem. Do not interpret zero code-search matches as proof of absence; locate exact current source/test/field evidence before promotion.
